blocks.text: LISBON, THE NIGHT BEFORE HE LEFT
BEFORE LEAVING, HE SPENT|ONE LAST NIGHT WITH JOHNNY.
A HANDFUL OF BRITISH TORPEDO|BOMBERS PUT THREE ITALIAN|BATTLESHIPS AT ANCHOR|OUT OF ACTION.
THEY WANT TO KNOW|HOW THE BRITISH|DID IT. DOWN TO THE|SMALLEST DETAIL.
A FLEET IN PORT. SHALLOW WATER.|TORPEDO BOMBERS. AND IN|HIS POCKET, PEARL HARBOR.
